verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a cloud telephony SaaS like Aircall, but the evidence pack never mentions region selection or data residency. The tutorial on importing recordings and voicemail into your own infrastructure is a developer-built export workaround, not product-level residency choice, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
